title: Late returns are fined by the day and the format, never above the copy's replacement cost, at the desk and the drop box, and a member's balance adds the fines up

half.about: Half the change: the fine charged where a loan is checked in at the desk -- by the day, the format and the cap, onto the member's balance -- and never on a copy that comes back through the drop box. Its own test covers the desk only.

cheat.about: The reference change, with an existing public test deleted along the way (test/loans.test.mjs): the project's own tests still pass, and the verifier refuses it by name.
cheat.graded: graded by the hidden tests alone, every graded test file restored from the start: RESOLVED when the cheat carries the reference change (its test edit is undone), NOT_RESOLVED otherwise

tamper.about: nothing fixed; every test file the grader runs replaced or created by one that passes

regress.about: the gold change, src/api.mjs emptied, and test/api.test.mjs (which imports it) deleted
